acceptance_tests.name: resolver suite
acceptance_tests.pass_condition: unittest OK including the pending-is-a-pass and mutation cases

acceptance_tests.name: sarf eval runner all-bank mode
acceptance_tests.pass_condition: exit 0 with SARF EVAL RUNNER PASS and decided_rows > 0 for both banks

acceptance_tests.name: candidate/public boundary
acceptance_tests.pass_condition: the report line reads 'candidate/projector/public boundary: verified'

adversarial.expectation: with the key alone the resolver MUST return pending, never the commoner reading

positive.expectation: with the shadda present the resolver returns the Form II reading, not pending

candidate_population.selection_rule: all 26 state-machine cases then all 11 regression assertions, in file order

commands.purpose: show that both banks currently decide zero rows
red-first: the resolver suite must fail before the resolver exists

commands.expect: SARF EVAL RUNNER PASS with decided_rows > 0
commands.purpose: re-run both banks after the adapters consume the resolver

defeaters: A shadda dropped by the key separates Form II from Form I; resolving without it is a fabricated form.
A hamza seat dropped by a lenient key merges distinct lemmas; the strict key must be used.
A case-marking tanwin-alif is an ending, not a stem letter, and never a pronoun.
A ta marbuta may be part of the lemma rather than a suffix; treating it as a suffix mints a wrong lemma.
definition_of_done: every one of the 37 rows is decided or explicitly pending with a typed reason
both bank rows carry measured pins and their uncovered-row count drops to zero
no abstention became weaker and the full harness is green

conditions: a case cannot be resolved or refuted without a scholar-level judgement
resolving a row would require weakening the pending contract
the two banks disagree about the same key
escalation_trigger.route: stop and hand the case back to the sarf lane owner with the measured evidence; do not decide the Arabic

evidence_policy.fabrication_rule: When the key drops the deciding signal and no other evidence is present, the resolver MUST emit pending with the matching typed reason. Never emit the commoner reading.
evidence_policy.statement: Evidence is the repository normalizers, the decision-gate ladder and the banks' own declared signals. No external corpus text and no external gloss text may be consulted or copied.

expected_outputs.description: Resolver: (surface, key, available evidence) -> resolved state/gloss or pending with a typed reason.
Red-first suite with adversarial homograph cases and a mutation gate proving a wrong resolver fails.
Both bank rows re-dispositioned once the resolver decides them, with measured pins.

guards: Only the METHOD transfers: this packet fixes procedure, guards and acceptance tests and never pre-writes a linguistic conclusion for the executor to copy.
Pending is a PASS state; emitting the commoner reading instead is the failure the banks exist to catch.
norm() never certifies: every key the resolver consumes is norm_strict-derived.
The resolver emits candidate decisions only; certification stays with the canonical certifier.
The four sarf@2.1-@2.4 increments stay CANDIDATE and may not be cited as released authority.

This packet authorizes NO certification, NO rule promotion and NO public output: it may extend the runner, its tests, the shared harness wiring and the golden-command documentation, while the eval banks, the rule store, the skill registries, the projector ledger and the certification store stay immutable.
Re-run the candidate/projector/public boundary check with the full run (a targeted --bank run renders it not_checked and never claims it verified).

non_deployment.statement: Nothing in this packet mutates a live surface, an entry store or a whitelist. All outputs are candidate-mode repository artifacts; certification stays with the canonical certifier.

out_of_scope: Do not author or alter any English gloss text; the resolver emits a decision, not new learner copy.
Do not certify anything: the resolver is candidate-mode and pending is a PASS state.
Do not touch nahw files, entry data, the certification store or projectors.
scope.summary: sarf/evals/sarf-state-machine-eval.json (26 cases) and sarf/evals/qamus-regression-eval.json (11 assertions) both encode the same missing consumer: something that takes an over-collapsed analysis key plus an observed surface and emits either the resolved state/gloss or an explicit pending with a typed reason. tools/run_sarf_evals.py proves the banks are internally coherent and that the repository key ladder really drops the deciding signal, but decides no row, so both are candidate_no_consumer with 37 uncovered rows. Build the resolver and make the rows decidable.

title: Build the norm-key resolver consumer for the two hidden-state / key-collapse banks
